conventions.plane: ℝ × ℝ with Mathlib's max norm (balls are squares)
conventions.integral: ∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(m * (Ψ k + L k)) * Complex.I) * A k (Lebesgue measure). Outside a statement, where Ψ k does not fix the type, write the cast as ((m * (Ψ k + L k) : ℝ) : ℂ), else elaboration fails with HMul ℝ ℝ ℂ. The D4 front ends (FE-S4.1′, FE-S4.1′L) use t * φ κ + L κ with L NOT scaled by t (uniform over all L).
conventions.linear_terms: L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ; a vector x is x.1 • fst + x.2 • snd
conventions.amplitudes: amplitude A : ℝ×ℝ → ℂ of class C² with tsupport A ⊆ K and ‖D^j A‖ ≤ M for j ≤ 2 (F1 gives M for any compactly supported Cⁿ A)
conventions.smooth: write ∞ (open scoped ContDiff) for C^∞; ContDiff ℝ ⊤ means analytic in this Mathlib
conventions.status: docs/STATUS.md is authoritative; this index does not state statuses
conventions.gradient_norm: ‖fderiv ℝ Ψ k + L‖ is the operator norm of a functional on ℝ × ℝ with the max norm, i.e. |a| + |b| for (a, b) ↦ a x + b y
conventions.smoothness_cast: C^{N+1} is ContDiff ℝ (↑N + 1) with N : ℕ; a numeral N may need ((3 : ℕ) + 1) to unify
conventions.hessian: OscInt.Statements.hessianMatrix Ψ k = Matrix.of fun i j => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Ψ k ![coordVec i, coordVec j], coordVec = ![(1,0),(0,1)]; nondegenerate means (hessianMatrix Ψ k).det ≠ 0
conventions.discriminant: disc / discr is Mathlib's Cubic.discr of a X³ + b X² + c X + d (C5), the discriminant of the binary cubic a x³ + b x²y + c xy² + d y³; discr < 0 hyperbolic, > 0 elliptic umbilic
conventions.multilinear_arguments: Statements apply D³φ(0) to ![(x, y), (x, y), (x, y)]; the Poly helpers produce (fun _ => v); convert with funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
conventions.rpow: t ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3) is Real.rpow; m ≥ 1 throughout
conventions.lean_statement: each entry's lean_statement is the frozen definition, verbatim from its statement file; the proving theorem has exactly this type

statements.label: S1.1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.VdC1Statement
statements.summary: First-derivative van der Corput bound with amplitude, constant 3.
statements.lean_statement:
def VdC1Statement : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ φ' φ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℂ) (a b ν : ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 < ν →
    HasDerivOn φ φ' a b → HasDerivOn φ' φ'' a b →
    (MonotoneOn φ' (Ioo a b) ∨ AntitoneOn φ' (Ioo a b)) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, ν ≤ |φ' x|) →
    AmplitudeOn ψ ψ' a b →
    ‖oscInt φ ψ a b‖ ≤ 3 / ν * ampNorm ψ ψ' a b
hypotheses: φ, φ′ with derivatives on [a, b] (continuous up to the endpoints)

statements.label: S1.2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.VdC2Statement
statements.summary: Second-derivative van der Corput bound with amplitude, constant 8, uniform in a linear term.
statements.lean_statement:
def VdC2Statement : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ φ' φ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℂ) (a b μ p : ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 < μ →
    HasDerivOn φ φ' a b → HasDerivOn φ' φ'' a b →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, μ ≤ |φ'' x|) →
    AmplitudeOn ψ ψ' a b →
    ‖oscInt (fun x => φ x + p * x) ψ a b‖ ≤ 8 / √μ * ampNorm ψ ψ' a b

statements.label: S1.3
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.VdC3Statement
statements.summary: Third-derivative van der Corput bound with amplitude, constant 18, uniform in a linear term.
statements.lean_statement:
def VdC3Statement : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ φ' φ'' φ''' : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℂ) (a b μ p : ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 < μ →
    HasDerivOn φ φ' a b → HasDerivOn φ' φ'' a b → HasDerivOn φ'' φ''' a b →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, μ ≤ |φ''' x|) →
    AmplitudeOn ψ ψ' a b →
    ‖oscInt (fun x => φ x + p * x) ψ a b‖ ≤ 18 * μ ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3) * ampNorm ψ ψ' a b

statements.label: S2.1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.NonStationaryStatement
statements.summary: Non-stationary phase: decay `m^{-N}`, uniform over a compact family and over every linear term with `|∇(Ψ_σ + p·)| ≥ c` on `K`.
statements.lean_statement:
def NonStationaryStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Λ : Type) [TopologicalSpace Λ] [CompactSpace Λ] (N : ℕ) (Ψ : Λ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (c : ℝ),
    FamilyCk (N + 1) Ψ → IsCompact K → 0 < c →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (σ : Λ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      AmpBound N K A M → (∀ k ∈ K, GradLower (Ψ σ) p k c) → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖oscInt2 (fun k => m * (Ψ σ k + lin p k)) A‖ ≤ C * M / m ^ N
statements.conclusion: |oscInt2(m(Ψ_σ + p·), A)| ≤ C M m^{-N} for AmpBound N K A M
statements.uniform_over: σ, p with the gradient bound, A, M

statements.label: S2.2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.StationaryPhaseStatement
statements.summary: Nondegenerate stationary phase: decay `m^{-1}`, uniform over `p ∈ K'`.
statements.lean_statement:
def StationaryPhaseStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K K' : Set (ℝ × ℝ)),
    ContDiff ℝ 4 Ψ → IsCompact K → IsCompact K' →
    (∀ p ∈ K', ∀ k ∈ K, IsCritical Ψ p k → hessDet Ψ k ≠ 0) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      AmpBound 2 K A M → p ∈ K' → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖oscInt2 (fun k => m * (Ψ k + lin p k)) A‖ ≤ C * M / m
hypotheses: Hessian nondegenerate at every critical point of Ψ + p· in K, p ∈ K′
statements.conclusion: bound C M m^{-1}

statements.label: S3
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.FoldStatement
statements.summary: Uniform fold estimate: decay `m^{-5/6}`, uniform over a compact family and over `p ∈ K'`.
statements.lean_statement:
def FoldStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Λ : Type) [TopologicalSpace Λ] [CompactSpace Λ] (Ψ : Λ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K K' : Set (ℝ × ℝ)),
    FamilyCk 4 Ψ → IsCompact K → IsCompact K' →
    (∀ σ, ∀ k ∈ K, FoldOrNondeg (Ψ σ) k) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (σ : Λ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      AmpBound 2 K A M → p ∈ K' → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖oscInt2 (fun k => m * (Ψ σ k + lin p k)) A‖ ≤ C * M * m ^ (-(5 : ℝ) / 6)
hypotheses: fold-or-nondegenerate at every point of K
statements.conclusion: bound C M m^{-5/6}

statements.label: S4.1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4BoundStatement
statements.summary: Uniform D4 estimate: at a point with vanishing Hessian whose cubic part has negative discriminant, `|∫ e^{i(tφ(κ) + y·κ)} A(κ) dκ| ≤ C M t^{-2/3}` for amplitudes supported near `0`, uniformly in `y ∈ ℝ²`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4BoundStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) → disc (cubicCoeffs φ) < 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (y : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      AmpBound 2 (Metric.closedBall 0 δ) A M → 1 ≤ t →
        ‖oscInt2 (fun κ => t * φ κ + lin y κ) A‖ ≤ C * M * t ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3)
statements.conclusion: ∃ δ, C: |oscInt2(tφ + y·, A)| ≤ C M t^{-2/3} for A supported in B̄(0, δ)
statements.uniform_over: all linear terms y, A, M

statements.label: S4.1′
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4BoundNeStatement
statements.summary: Uniform D4 estimate at both umbilics: as `D4BoundStatement` with `disc ≠ 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4BoundNeStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) → disc (cubicCoeffs φ) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (y : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      AmpBound 2 (Metric.closedBall 0 δ) A M → 1 ≤ t →
        ‖oscInt2 (fun κ => t * φ κ + lin y κ) A‖ ≤ C * M * t ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3)
statements.conclusion: as S4.1

statements.label: S4.2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4LimitStatement
statements.summary: D4 limit: `t^{2/3} ∫ e^{itφ} A → c_C A(0)`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4LimitStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → φ 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ φ 0 = 0 → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) →
    disc (cubicCoeffs φ) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), AmpBound 2 (Metric.closedBall 0 δ) A M →
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) : ℝ) : ℂ) * oscInt2 (fun κ => t * φ κ) A) atTop
        (𝓝 ((d4Constant (cubicCoeffs φ) : ℂ) * A 0))
statements.conclusion: t^{2/3} oscInt2(tφ, A) → c_C A(0) for A supported in B̄(0, δ)

statements.label: S4.3
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4ConstantPosStatement
statements.summary: The constant is positive: the improper integral converges to a positive number, and for `disc ≠ 0` the angular integrand is integrable and `c_C > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4ConstantPosStatement : Prop :=
  Tendsto cosMomentPartial atTop (𝓝 cosMoment) ∧ 0 < cosMoment ∧
    ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, disc q ≠ 0 →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => |cubicForm q (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ)| ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧ 0 < d4Constant q
statements.conclusion: c_C(q) > 0 (and the defining improper integral converges)

statements.label: S4.4
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4ConstantClosedFormStatement
statements.summary: Closed forms: `∫₀^∞ cos u · u^{-1/3} du = Γ(2/3)/2`; `c_C = Γ(1/3)²/(√3 |Disc|^{1/6})` for `Disc < 0` and `c_C = Γ(1/3)²/Disc^{1/6}` for `Disc > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4ConstantClosedFormStatement : Prop :=
  cosMoment = Real.Gamma (2 / 3) / 2 ∧
    (∀ q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, disc q < 0 →
      d4Constant q = Real.Gamma (1 / 3) ^ 2 / (Real.sqrt 3 * |disc q| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6))) ∧
    ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, 0 < disc q → d4Constant q = Real.Gamma (1 / 3) ^ 2 / disc q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6)

statements.label: F1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.AmpBoundOfContDiffStatement
statements.summary: Amplitude bounds from Mathlib's idiom: a `Cⁿ` amplitude with `tsupport A ⊆ K`, `K` compact, satisfies `AmpBound n K A M` for some `M`.
hypotheses: A of class Cⁿ with tsupport A ⊆ K
statements.conclusion: ∃ M, AmpBound n K A M

statements.label: F2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4LimitClosedFormStatement
statements.summary: The D4 limit with its closed-form constant (the brief's S4), for a `C²` amplitude supported near `0`: `t^{2/3} ∫ e^{itφ} A → Γ(1/3)²/(√3 |Disc|^{1/6}) A(0)` if `Disc < 0`, and `→ Γ(1/3)²/Disc^{1/6} A(0)` if `Disc > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4LimitClosedFormStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → φ 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ φ 0 = 0 → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) →
    disc (cubicCoeffs φ) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ 2 A → tsupport A ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 δ →
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(t * φ k) * Complex.I) * A k) atTop
        (𝓝 ((d4ClosedConstant (disc (cubicCoeffs φ)) : ℂ) * A 0))
hypotheses: A of class C² supported in B̄(0, δ)
statements.conclusion: t^{2/3} ∫ e^{itφ} A → d4ClosedConstant(disc) A(0)

statements.label: C1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.DdEqIteratedStatement
statements.summary: Second derivatives: `dd Ψ k v w = D²Ψ(k)[v, w]` for `Ψ` of class `C²` near `k`.
statements.lean_statement:
def DdEqIteratedStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Ψ k → ∀ v w, dd Ψ k v w = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Ψ k ![v, w]
statements.conclusion: dd Ψ k v w = D²Ψ(k)[v, w] for Ψ C² near k

statements.name: OscInt.Statements.DddEqIteratedStatement
statements.summary: Third derivatives: `ddd Ψ k u v w = D³Ψ(k)[u, v, w]` for `Ψ` of class `C³` near `k`.
statements.conclusion: ddd = D³Ψ(k)[u, v, w] for Ψ C³ near k

statements.label: C3
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.HessDetEqDetStatement
statements.summary: `hessDet Ψ k = det (hessianMatrix Ψ k)` for `Ψ` of class `C²` near `k`.
statements.lean_statement:
def HessDetEqDetStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Ψ k → hessDet Ψ k = (hessianMatrix Ψ k).det
statements.conclusion: hessDet Ψ k = det (hessianMatrix Ψ k) for Ψ C² near k

statements.label: C4
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.CubicCoeffsEqStatement
statements.summary: The cubic part: `cubicForm (cubicCoeffs φ) κ = D³φ(0)[κ, κ, κ] / 6` for `φ` of class `C³` near `0`.

statements.name: OscInt.Statements.DiscEqCubicDiscrStatement
statements.summary: `disc` is Mathlib's discriminant of the cubic polynomial `a X³ + b X² + c X + d`.

def DiscEqCubicDiscrStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ a b c d : ℝ, disc (a, b, c, d) = (Cubic.mk a b c d).discr
statements.conclusion: disc (a, b, c, d) = (Cubic.mk a b c d).discr

statements.label: C6
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.DiscNeZeroIffIsolatedStatement
statements.summary: `disc q ≠ 0` iff `0` is an isolated critical point of the binary cubic `cubicForm q`.
statements.lean_statement:
def DiscNeZeroIffIsolatedStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, disc q ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ × ℝ), fderiv ℝ (cubicForm q) z ≠ 0
statements.conclusion: disc q ≠ 0 iff 0 is an isolated critical point of the binary cubic

statements.label: C7
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.FoldOrNondegIffStatement
statements.summary: `FoldOrNondeg` in matrix form (span form and rank form) for `Ψ` of class `C³` near `k`.
statements.lean_statement:
def FoldOrNondegIffStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 Ψ k →
    (FoldOrNondeg Ψ k ↔ FoldOrNondegMatrix Ψ k) ∧
      (FoldOrNondeg Ψ k ↔
        FoldCondRank (hessianMatrix Ψ k) (fun e => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 Ψ k ![ofFin2 e, ofFin2 e, ofFin2 e]))
statements.conclusion: FoldOrNondeg ↔ FoldOrNondegMatrix (span form) ↔ rank form, for Ψ C³ near k

statements.label: C7′
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.FoldOrNondegOfHasFDerivStatement
statements.summary: `FoldOrNondeg` from derivative data: `Ψ' = D₁`, `D₁' = D₂` everywhere and `D₂'(k) = D₃`.
statements.lean_statement:
def FoldOrNondegOfHasFDerivStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (D₁ : ℝ × ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D₂ : ℝ × ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (D₃ : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (k : ℝ × ℝ),
    (∀ y, HasFDerivAt Ψ (D₁ y) y) → (∀ y, HasFDerivAt D₁ (D₂ y) y) → HasFDerivAt D₂ D₃ k →
    (FoldOrNondeg Ψ k ↔
      FoldCondSpan (Matrix.of fun i j => D₂ k (coordVec i) (coordVec j))
        (fun e => D₃ (ofFin2 e) (ofFin2 e) (ofFin2 e)))
statements.conclusion: FoldOrNondeg from HasFDerivAt data D₁, D₂, D₃

statements.label: C8
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.GradLowerIffStatement
statements.summary: `GradLower` as a norm bound: Euclidean (an equivalence) and max norm (both directions, losing `√2`).
statements.lean_statement:
def GradLowerIffStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p k : ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ k → 0 ≤ c →
    (GradLower Ψ p k c ↔
        c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => Ψ (x 0, x 1) + lin p (x 0, x 1)) (toEuclid k)‖) ∧
      (GradLower Ψ p k c → c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => Ψ x + lin p x) k‖) ∧
      (c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => Ψ x + lin p x) k‖ → GradLower Ψ p k (c / Real.sqrt 2))
statements.conclusion: GradLower ↔ Euclidean gradient bound; max-norm bounds losing √2

statements.label: C9
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.AmpBoundConvStatement
statements.summary: `AmpBound` and Mathlib's idiom: (i) on a compact `K` it gives `Cⁿ` with compact support; (ii) `Cⁿ` with compact support gives `AmpBound n (tsupport A) A M` for some `M`.
statements.lean_statement:
def AmpBoundConvStatement : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), IsCompact K → AmpBound n K A M →
      ContDiff ℝ n A ∧ HasCompactSupport A) ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ n A → HasCompactSupport A → ∃ M : ℝ, AmpBound n (tsupport A) A M
statements.conclusion: AmpBound ↔ ContDiff with compact support

statements.label: FE-S2.1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.NonStationaryFEStatement
statements.summary: Non-stationary phase in Mathlib's idiom (one phase): decay `m^{-N}`, uniform over amplitudes with derivative bound `M` and over linear terms `L` with `‖DΨ(k) + L‖ ≥ c` on `K`.
statements.lean_statement:
def NonStationaryFEStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (N + 1) Ψ → IsCompact K → 0 < c →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ N A → tsupport A ⊆ K → (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j A k‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ k ∈ K, c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Ψ k + L‖) → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(m * (Ψ k + L k)) * Complex.I) * A k‖ ≤ C * M / m ^ N
statements.conclusion: |∫ e^{im(Ψ+L)} A| ≤ C M m^{-N} for amplitudes (N, K, M)
statements.uniform_over: L with the gradient bound, A, M

statements.label: FE-S2.2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.StationaryPhaseFEStatement
statements.summary: Nondegenerate stationary phase in Mathlib's idiom: decay `m^{-1}`, uniform over `L ∈ K'`.
statements.lean_statement:
def StationaryPhaseFEStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (K' : Set ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)),
    ContDiff ℝ 4 Ψ → IsCompact K → IsCompact K' →
    (∀ L ∈ K', ∀ k ∈ K, fderiv ℝ Ψ k + L = 0 → (hessianMatrix Ψ k).det ≠ 0) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 A → tsupport A ⊆ K → (∀ j ≤ 2, ∀ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j A k‖ ≤ M) → L ∈ K' → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(m * (Ψ k + L k)) * Complex.I) * A k‖ ≤ C * M / m
hypotheses: Hessian matrix invertible at critical points of Ψ + L, L ∈ K′

statements.name: OscInt.Statements.LatticeKernel1LightConeStatement
statements.summary: Light-cone bound for the 1D lattice kernel: `|I(t, n)| ≤ 2π e^{|t| sinh η − |n| η}` for every real `t`, integer `n` and `η ≥ 0`.
statements.conclusion: |∫_{−π}^{π} e^{i(t cos k + nk)} dk| ≤ 2π e^{|t| sinh η − |n| η} (light cone of the 1D lattice kernel; for t ≠ 0 and |n| ≥ |t| the choice cosh η = |n|/|t| gives the right side of DLMF 10.14.5, Siegel's bound; integer n only)
statements.rate: e^{−η|n|} for each fixed η and t; exponential in |n| along rays |n| = c|t|, c > 1, with a rate that tends to 0 as c → 1

statements.label: KL-D
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.KusminLandauStatement
statements.summary: The Kusmin–Landau inequality in Landau's sharp form, on differences: `|Σ_{n=0}^{N} e(c_n)| ≤ cot(πλ/2)`.
hypotheses: the N differences c_{n+1} − c_n are monotone and lie in [k + λ, k + 1 − λ] (DiffsMonotoneIn c N k λ)
statements.conclusion: |Σ_{n=0}^{N} e^{2πi c_n}| ≤ cot(πλ/2) (Kusmin–Landau with Landau's constant; attained for λ = 1/3 by c = 0, 1/3, 1; that the constant is best possible for every λ is Landau's result, not machine-checked here)

statements.label: KL-C
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.KusminLandauTwoOverPiStatement
statements.summary: The Kusmin–Landau inequality with the constant `2/π`: `|Σ_{n=0}^{N} e(c_n)| ≤ 2/(πλ)`.
statements.conclusion: |Σ_{n=0}^{N} e^{2πi c_n}| ≤ 2/(πλ) (the constant 2/π, not 1/π)

statements.label: KL-F
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.KusminLandauDerivStatement
statements.summary: The Kusmin–Landau inequality in its textbook form: `f′` monotone on `(a, b)` with values in `[k + λ, k + 1 − λ]` gives `|Σ_{a ≤ n ≤ b} e(f(n))| ≤ cot(πλ/2)`.
statements.lean_statement:
def KusminLandauDerivStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 / 2 → HasDerivOn f f' a b →
    (MonotoneOn f' (Ioo a b) ∨ AntitoneOn f' (Ioo a b)) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, (k : ℝ) + lam ≤ f' x ∧ f' x ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 - lam) →
    ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc ⌈a⌉ ⌊b⌋, Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * f (n : ℝ)) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      Real.cos (Real.pi * lam / 2) / Real.sin (Real.pi * lam / 2)
hypotheses: f continuous on [a, b] with derivative f′ on (a, b) (HasDerivOn)
statements.conclusion: |Σ_{n ∈ ℤ, a ≤ n ≤ b} e^{2πi f(n)}| ≤ cot(πλ/2) (the textbook form of the Kusmin–Landau inequality)
statements.rate: bounded independently of the length of the sum (explicit constant)
statements.uniform_over: a, b, k, every admissible f

statements.label: FR-K
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.RingKernelStatement
statements.summary: The ring kernel solves `i ∂_t R + ΔR = 0` in the site variable, equals the unit datum of the ring at `t = 0` (1 on `Nℤ`, 0 elsewhere) and has period `N`.
statements.lean_statement:
def RingKernelStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (r : ℤ), 0 < N →
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ringKernel N s r)
      (Complex.I * (ringKernel N t (r + 1) + ringKernel N t (r - 1) - 2 * ringKernel N t r)) t ∧
    ringKernel N 0 r = (if (N : ℤ) ∣ r then 1 else 0) ∧
    ringKernel N t (r + (N : ℤ)) = ringKernel N t r
hypotheses: N ∈ ℕ, N ≥ 1; t ∈ ℝ; r ∈ ℤ
statements.conclusion: the ring kernel R_N(t, r) = N^{−1} Σ_{j<N} e^{i(2t(cos k_j − 1) + r k_j)}, k_j = 2πj/N, satisfies ∂_t R = i(R(r+1) + R(r−1) − 2R(r)), R_N(0, r) = [N | r], R_N(t, r + N) = R_N(t, r)

statements.label: FR-U
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.RingUniqueStatement
statements.summary: Every solution of period `N` of `i u′ + Δu = 0` is the kernel sum of its datum over one period: `u(t, x) = Σ_{y<N} R_N(t, x − y) u(0, y)`.
statements.lean_statement:
def RingUniqueStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (u : ℝ → ℤ → ℂ), 0 < N → (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ), u t (x + (N : ℤ)) = u t x) →
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ), HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => u s x) (Complex.I * (u t (x + 1) + u t (x - 1) - 2 * u t x)) t) →
    ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ), u t x = ∑ y ∈ Finset.range N, ringKernel N t (x - (y : ℤ)) * u 0 (y : ℤ)
hypotheses: u : ℝ → ℤ → ℂ with u(t, x + N) = u(t, x)
∂_t u(t, x) = i(u(t, x+1) + u(t, x−1) − 2u(t, x)) for all t, x
statements.conclusion: u(t, x) = Σ_{y<N} R_N(t, x − y) u(0, y): the ring kernel is the propagator of i u′ + Δu = 0 on the ring of N sites (uniqueness)
statements.smoothness: differentiable in t, site by site

statements.label: FR-S
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.RingCosetSumStatement
statements.summary: Method of images: the ring kernel is the line kernel summed over the coset `r + Nℤ`.
statements.conclusion: Σ_{m ∈ ℤ} G(t, r + mN) = R_N(t, r) (HasSum): the ring kernel is the line kernel G(t, n) = (2π)^{−1} e^{−2it} I(2t, n) summed over the images r + Nℤ

statements.label: FR-P
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.RingFiniteSizeStatement
statements.summary: Finite-size error of the ring: `|R_N(t, r) − G(t, r)| ≤ 2 e^{2|t| sinh η} cosh(rη) / (e^{ηN} − 1)` for every `η > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def RingFiniteSizeStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (t η : ℝ) (r : ℤ), 0 < N → 0 < η →
    ‖ringKernel N t r - lineKernel t r‖ ≤
      2 * Real.exp (2 * |t| * Real.sinh η) * Real.cosh ((r : ℝ) * η) / (Real.exp (η * (N : ℝ)) - 1)
statements.conclusion: |R_N(t, r) − G(t, r)| ≤ 2 e^{2|t| sinh η} cosh(rη) / (e^{ηN} − 1): the ring of N sites differs from the infinite line by an explicit, exponentially small amount until the wave wraps around
statements.rate: e^{−η(N − |r|)} for each fixed η and t
statements.uniform_over: N, t, r, η (R_N has period N in r and the bound has not: use the representative with |r| ≤ N/2; for |r| ≥ N the bound exceeds 1)

statements.label: FC-K
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.ChainKernelStatement
statements.summary: The chain kernel solves the equation in the site variable, vanishes at the walls `x = 0` and `x = M + 1`, and is the unit datum at `t = 0` on the sites `1, …, M`.
statements.lean_statement:
def ChainKernelStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (x y : ℤ), 1 ≤ y → y ≤ (M : ℤ) →
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => chainKernel M s x y)
      (Complex.I * (chainKernel M t (x + 1) y + chainKernel M t (x - 1) y - 2 * chainKernel M t x y)) t ∧
    chainKernel M t 0 y = 0 ∧ chainKernel M t ((M : ℤ) + 1) y = 0 ∧
    (1 ≤ x → x ≤ (M : ℤ) → chainKernel M 0 x y = (if x = y then 1 else 0))
hypotheses: M ∈ ℕ; t ∈ ℝ; x, y ∈ ℤ with 1 ≤ y ≤ M
statements.conclusion: the chain kernel C_M(t; x, y) = R_{2(M+1)}(t, x − y) − R_{2(M+1)}(t, x + y) satisfies the equation in x, vanishes at the walls x = 0 and x = M + 1, and C_M(0; x, y) = δ_{xy} for 1 ≤ x ≤ M

statements.label: FC-U
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.ChainUniqueStatement
statements.summary: Every solution of `i u′ + Δu = 0` on the open chain `1, …, M` with `u = 0` at the walls `0` and `M + 1` is the kernel sum of its datum: `u(t, x) = Σ_{y=1}^{M} C_M(t; x, y) u(0, y)`.
statements.lean_statement:
def ChainUniqueStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : ℕ) (u : ℝ → ℤ → ℂ), (∀ t : ℝ, u t 0 = 0 ∧ u t ((M : ℤ) + 1) = 0) →
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ), 1 ≤ x → x ≤ (M : ℤ) →
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => u s x) (Complex.I * (u t (x + 1) + u t (x - 1) - 2 * u t x)) t) →
    ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ), 1 ≤ x → x ≤ (M : ℤ) →
      u t x = ∑ y ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) (M : ℤ), chainKernel M t x y * u 0 y
hypotheses: u : ℝ → ℤ → ℂ with u(t, 0) = u(t, M + 1) = 0
∂_t u(t, x) = i(u(t, x+1) + u(t, x−1) − 2u(t, x)) for all t and 1 ≤ x ≤ M
statements.conclusion: u(t, x) = Σ_{y=1}^{M} C_M(t; x, y) u(0, y) for 1 ≤ x ≤ M: the chain kernel is the propagator of the open chain of M identical sites (Dirichlet walls; uniqueness)
statements.smoothness: differentiable in t, site by site

statements.label: FC-P
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.ChainFiniteSizeStatement
statements.summary: Finite-size error of the open chain: for sites `1 ≤ x, y ≤ M` and every `η > 0`, `|C_M(t; x, y) − G(t, x − y)| ≤ e^{2|t| sinh η} (e^{−(x+y)η} + 2 (cosh((x−y)η) + cosh((x+y)η)) / (e^{2(M+1)η} − 1))`.
statements.lean_statement:
def ChainFiniteSizeStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : ℕ) (t η : ℝ) (x y : ℤ), 0 < η → 1 ≤ x → x ≤ (M : ℤ) → 1 ≤ y → y ≤ (M : ℤ) →
    ‖chainKernel M t x y - lineKernel t (x - y)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (2 * |t| * Real.sinh η) *
        (Real.exp (-(((x + y : ℤ) : ℝ) * η)) +
          2 * (Real.cosh (((x - y : ℤ) : ℝ) * η) + Real.cosh (((x + y : ℤ) : ℝ) * η)) /
            (Real.exp (2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) * η) - 1))
hypotheses: M ∈ ℕ; t ∈ ℝ; sites 1 ≤ x, y ≤ M
statements.conclusion: |C_M(t; x, y) − G(t, x − y)| ≤ e^{2|t| sinh η} (e^{−(x+y)η} + 2(cosh((x−y)η) + cosh((x+y)η))/(e^{2(M+1)η} − 1)) for sites 1 ≤ x, y ≤ M: the open chain differs from the infinite line by its images in the two walls, each bounded explicitly
statements.rate: e^{−η · (distance to the nearest image)} for each fixed η and t

statements.label: VC2-S
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.SecondDerivSharpStatement
statements.summary: The second-derivative van der Corput bound with its sharp constant: if `f′` increases at rate at least `λ > 0`, then `|∫_a^b e^{if}| ≤ A(w)/√λ` for some `w ∈ [0, π]`.
statements.lean_statement:
def SecondDerivSharpStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b lam : ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 < lam → HasDerivOn f f' a b → DerivIncreasesAtRate f' a b lam →
    ∃ w ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi,
      ‖∫ x in a..b, Complex.exp (((f x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ vdc2Profile w / Real.sqrt lam
hypotheses: f continuous on [a, b], differentiable on (a, b) with derivative f′
f′(y) − f′(x) ≥ λ (y − x) for a < x ≤ y < b (for instance f″ ≥ λ)
statements.conclusion: there is w ∈ [0, π] with |∫_a^b e^{if}| ≤ A(w)/√λ, where A(w) = 2 ∫_0^{√(2w)} sin(w − u²/2) du: the second-derivative van der Corput bound with its sharp constant sup A (numerically 3.3643…, not a Lean theorem: in Lean 3.35 < sup A ≤ 7/2; classical for f″ ≥ λ by citation, attributed to Kershner, originals unread)
statements.uniform_over: f, a, b (no amplitude, no second derivative needed)
statements.smoothness: f differentiable on (a, b); f′ may be unbounded at the ends

statements.label: VC2-A
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.SecondDerivAttainedStatement
statements.summary: The bound of VC2-S is attained by the quadratic phase: `A(w) ≤ |∫_{−√(2w)}^{√(2w)} e^{ix²/2} dx|`.
statements.lean_statement:
def SecondDerivAttainedStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ w : ℝ, 0 ≤ w →
    vdc2Profile w ≤
      ‖∫ x in (-Real.sqrt (2 * w))..(Real.sqrt (2 * w)), Complex.exp (((x ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
statements.conclusion: A(w) ≤ |∫_{−√(2w)}^{√(2w)} e^{ix²/2} dx|: the quadratic phase on a symmetric interval reaches the profile, so no constant below sup_{[0, π]} A is true in VC2-S

statements.label: VC2-N
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.Vdc2ProfileBoundStatement
statements.summary: An explicit bound for the sharp constant: `A(w) ≤ 7/2` for `0 ≤ w ≤ π`.
statements.lean_statement:
def Vdc2ProfileBoundStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ w ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi, vdc2Profile w ≤ 7 / 2
statements.conclusion: A(w) ≤ 7/2 (numerically the supremum is 3.3643175781…, by ball arithmetic outside Lean; 7/2 is 4 % above it)

statements.label: VC2-K
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.SecondDerivSevenHalvesStatement
statements.summary: The second-derivative test with amplitude and a linear term, constant `7/2`: `|∫_a^b e^{i(φ(x) + px)} ψ(x) dx| ≤ (7/2) μ^{−1/2} (|ψ(b)| + ∫_a^b |ψ′|)` when `|φ″| ≥ μ > 0` on `(a, b)`.
statements.lean_statement:
def SecondDerivSevenHalvesStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ φ' φ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℂ) (a b μ p : ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 < μ →
    HasDerivOn φ φ' a b → HasDerivOn φ' φ'' a b → (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, μ ≤ |φ'' x|) → AmplitudeOn ψ ψ' a b →
    ‖oscInt (fun x => φ x + p * x) ψ a b‖ ≤ (7 / 2 : ℝ) * μ ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) * ampNorm ψ ψ' a b
statements.conclusion: |∫_a^b e^{i(φ+px)} ψ| ≤ (7/2) μ^{-1/2} (|ψ(b)| + ∫|ψ′|): S1.2 with the constant 7/2 in place of 8
statements.smoothness: φ continuous on [a, b] with derivative φ′ on (a, b); φ′ continuous on [a, b] with derivative φ″ on (a, b); φ″ need not be continuous (as S1.2)

statements.label: HW-R
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.HadamardKernelStatement
statements.summary: The walk from a point state in terms of the scalar kernel: for every `t ≥ 0`, `ψ_{t+1}(x) = ((a + b)/√2 · K(t+1, x+1) + a K(t, x), (a − b)/√2 · K(t+1, x−1) + b K(t, x))`.
statements.lean_statement:
def HadamardKernelStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : ℂ) (t : ℕ) (x : ℤ),
    hadamardWalk (pointState a b) (t + 1) x =
      ((a + b) / ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * hadamardKernel (t + 1) (x + 1) + a * hadamardKernel t x,
        (a - b) / ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * hadamardKernel (t + 1) (x - 1) + b * hadamardKernel t x)
hypotheses: a, b ∈ ℂ; t ∈ ℕ; x ∈ ℤ
statements.conclusion: U^{t+1} δ_{a,b}(x) = ((a + b)/√2 · K(t+1, x+1) + a K(t, x), (a − b)/√2 · K(t+1, x−1) + b K(t, x)): the Hadamard walk on ℤ from a point state in terms of one scalar kernel K, a Fourier integral over the dispersion relation ω(k) = arcsin(sin k/√2)

statements.label: HW-K
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.HadamardKernelBoundStatement
statements.summary: Explicit bound for the scalar kernel: `|K(t, x)| ≤ 7 t^{−1/2} + 12 t^{−1/3}` for `t ≥ 1` and every site `x`.
statements.conclusion: |K(t, x)| ≤ 7 t^{−1/2} + 12 t^{−1/3}: explicit bound for the scalar kernel of the Hadamard walk, uniform in the site (constants of the classical route, not sharp: numerically sup_x |K| t^{1/3} is 1 at t = 1 and at most 0.9637 for t ≥ 2; the bound is implied by the L¹ bound 1.18034 of the kernel for t ≤ 1679)

statements.label: HW-D
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.HadamardDecayStatement
statements.summary: Decay of the Hadamard walk from a point state: each component of `ψ_t(x)` is at most `39 (|a| + |b|) t^{−1/3}`, for `t ≥ 1` and every site `x`.
statements.lean_statement:
def HadamardDecayStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : ℂ) (t : ℕ) (x : ℤ), 1 ≤ t →
    ‖(hadamardWalk (pointState a b) t x).1‖ ≤ 39 * (‖a‖ + ‖b‖) * (t : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3) ∧
    ‖(hadamardWalk (pointState a b) t x).2‖ ≤ 39 * (‖a‖ + ‖b‖) * (t : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3)
hypotheses: a, b ∈ ℂ; t ∈ ℕ, t ≥ 1; x ∈ ℤ
statements.conclusion: each component of U^t δ_{a,b}(x) has modulus at most 39 (|a| + |b|) t^{−1/3}: the amplitudes of the Hadamard walk from a point state decay like t^{−1/3} uniformly in the site, with an explicit constant (not sharp: numerically at most 1.6208 t^{−1/3} from the state (1, 0) for t ≤ 3000; for t ≤ 59319 the bound is implied by conservation of the ℓ² norm, which is not a theorem of this library)
statements.uniform_over: the site x and the initial coin state (a, b)

statements.label: HW-L
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.HadamardDispersiveStatement
statements.summary: The dispersive estimate `ℓ¹ → ℓ^∞` for finitely supported initial states: each component of `ψ_t(x)` is at most `39 t^{−1/3} ∑_y (|ψ₀(y)₁| + |ψ₀(y)₂|)`, for `t ≥ 1` and every site `x`.
statements.lean_statement:
def HadamardDispersiveStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (ψ₀ : ℤ → ℂ × ℂ) (t : ℕ) (x : ℤ), {y : ℤ | ψ₀ y ≠ (0, 0)}.Finite → 1 ≤ t →
    ‖(hadamardWalk ψ₀ t x).1‖ ≤
      39 * (∑ᶠ y : ℤ, (‖(ψ₀ y).1‖ + ‖(ψ₀ y).2‖)) * (t : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3) ∧
    ‖(hadamardWalk ψ₀ t x).2‖ ≤
      39 * (∑ᶠ y : ℤ, (‖(ψ₀ y).1‖ + ‖(ψ₀ y).2‖)) * (t : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3)
hypotheses: ψ₀ : ℤ → ℂ² of finite support
statements.conclusion: each component of U^t ψ₀(x) has modulus at most 39 t^{−1/3} Σ_y (|ψ₀,₁(y)| + |ψ₀,₂(y)|): the dispersive estimate ℓ¹ → ℓ^∞ of the Hadamard walk with an explicit constant (not sharp; finitely supported initial states only; for a point state no content before t > 59319)
statements.uniform_over: the site x and the initial state

statements.label: SPL-I
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.StationaryLeadingIdentityStatement
statements.summary: The remainder of the quadratic-phase leading term as an integral of `g‴` against the kernel: `R(g, λ) = −i λ^{−3/2} ∫ g‴(t) κ(√λ t) dt`.
statements.lean_statement:
def StationaryLeadingIdentityStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (g g₁ g₂ g₃ : ℝ → ℂ) (lam : ℝ), SplAmplitude g g₁ g₂ g₃ → 0 < lam →
    splRemainder g lam =
      -Complex.I * ((lam ^ (-(3 : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ t, g₃ t * splKernel (Real.sqrt lam * t)
hypotheses: g with derivatives g₁, g₂, g₃ at every point (HasDerivAt), and g, g₁, g₂, g₃ integrable on ℝ
statements.conclusion: R(g, λ) = −i λ^{−3/2} ∫ g₃(t) κ(√λ t) dt, where R(g, λ) = ∫ g(u) e^{iλu²/2} du − g(0) √(2π/λ) e^{iπ/4} and κ is the odd kernel built from the Fresnel primitive (classical in substance: Erdélyi's remainder representation, two-sided)
statements.uniform_over: an identity; nothing to be uniform over
statements.smoothness: three derivatives given as functions with HasDerivAt at every point; g₃ need not be continuous, but as a derivative it has no jump, so piecewise C³ amplitudes are excluded; no compact support

statements.label: SPL-S
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.StationaryLeadingStatement
statements.summary: The leading term of the quadratic-phase integral with its remainder bounded through the kernel: `|R(g, λ)| ≤ |κ(τ)| ‖g‴‖₁ λ^{−3/2}` for some `τ ≥ 0`.
hypotheses: g with derivatives g₁, g₂, g₃ at every point (HasDerivAt), and g, g₁, g₂, g₃ integrable on ℝ
statements.conclusion: there is τ ≥ 0 with |R(g, λ)| ≤ |κ(τ)| ‖g₃‖₁ λ^{−3/2}: the leading term of the quadratic-phase integral with its remainder bounded through the kernel
statements.uniform_over: g and λ (the witness τ may depend on both)
statements.smoothness: three derivatives given as functions with HasDerivAt at every point; g₃ need not be continuous, but as a derivative it has no jump, so piecewise C³ amplitudes are excluded; no compact support

statements.label: SPL-K
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.StationaryLeadingSevenEighthsStatement
statements.summary: The leading term of the quadratic-phase integral with remainder at most `(7/8) ‖g‴‖₁ λ^{−3/2}`.
hypotheses: g with derivatives g₁, g₂, g₃ at every point (HasDerivAt), and g, g₁, g₂, g₃ integrable on ℝ
statements.conclusion: |∫ g(u) e^{iλu²/2} du − g(0) √(2π/λ) e^{iπ/4}| ≤ (7/8) ‖g₃‖₁ λ^{−3/2} (7/8 is not the best constant; numerically the best is about 0.722)
statements.uniform_over: g and λ > 0 (every λ, not only large)
statements.smoothness: three derivatives given as functions with HasDerivAt at every point; g₃ need not be continuous, but as a derivative it has no jump, so piecewise C³ amplitudes are excluded; no compact support

statements.label: SPL-A
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.StationaryLeadingAttainedStatement
statements.summary: The kernel bound of SPL-S is attained in the limit by smooth compactly supported amplitudes: for every `τ ≥ 0` and `ε > 0` some such `g ≠ 0` has `|R(g, 1)| ≥ (|κ(τ)| − ε) ‖g‴‖₁`.
statements.lean_statement:
def StationaryLeadingAttainedStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ τ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → 0 < ε →
    ∃ g g₁ g₂ g₃ : ℝ → ℂ, SplAmplitude g g₁ g₂ g₃ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∃ x, g x ≠ 0) ∧
      (‖splKernel τ‖ - ε) * (∫ t, ‖g₃ t‖) ≤ ‖splRemainder g 1‖
statements.conclusion: some infinitely differentiable, compactly supported amplitude g ≠ 0 has |R(g, 1)| ≥ (|κ(τ)| − ε) ‖g₃‖₁: the kernel bound of SPL-S is approached to any tolerance, so no constant below sup |κ| is true in SPL-K

statements.label: TRI-K
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.TriClassificationStatement
statements.summary: Classification of the anisotropic triangular lattice phase: for `α ≠ 0` every point is of type A1 or A2, A3, or A5 (no A4 and no D-type point).
statements.summary_note: The frozen docstring's "no A4" is an informal reading, not proved in Lean: the disjunction is not exclusive and IsA5Point asks only for some (v, w, curve). "No D-type point" (no Hessian-zero point) does follow. docs/statements.md, clarification TRI-c.
hypotheses: k any point of ℝ × ℝ
statements.conclusion: k is A1 or A2 (FoldOrNondeg), A3 (IsA3Point) or A5 (IsA5Point) for cos k₁ + cos k₂ + α cos(k₁ + k₂); the three cases are not proved exclusive; no point has Hessian zero (each case needs D²Ψ[w, w] ≠ 0 for some w)

statements.label: TRI-X
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.TriA5LocusStatement
statements.summary: The A5 locus: A5 points of the anisotropic triangular lattice phase occur only for `|α| = 1/(2√2)`, and only at `(θ, −θ)` or `(−θ, θ)` modulo `2π`, with `θ = arccos(−2α)`.
statements.lean_statement:
def TriA5LocusStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, ∀ k : ℝ × ℝ, IsA5Point (triPhase α) k →
    |α| = triExceptional ∧
      ∃ j₁ j₂ : ℤ,
        k = (Real.arccos (-2 * α) + 2 * Real.pi * j₁, -Real.arccos (-2 * α) + 2 * Real.pi * j₂) ∨
          k = (-Real.arccos (-2 * α) + 2 * Real.pi * j₁, Real.arccos (-2 * α) + 2 * Real.pi * j₂)
hypotheses: k an A5 point of triPhase α
statements.conclusion: |α| = 1/(2√2), and k is (θ, −θ) or (−θ, θ) modulo 2π in each coordinate, θ = arccos(−2α)

statements.label: TRI-W
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.TriA5WitnessStatement
statements.summary: The A5 witness: for `|α| = 1/(2√2)` the points `(θ, −θ)` and `(−θ, θ)`, `θ = arccos(−2α)`, are A5 points, and with `v = (1, 1)`, `w = (1, −1)` every reduced curve at `(θ, −θ)` has reduced sixth derivative `−60√2 · sign α` at `0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def TriA5WitnessStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, |α| = triExceptional →
    IsA5Point (triPhase α) (Real.arccos (-2 * α), -Real.arccos (-2 * α)) ∧
      IsA5Point (triPhase α) (-Real.arccos (-2 * α), Real.arccos (-2 * α)) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε →
        ReducedCurve (triPhase α) (Real.arccos (-2 * α), -Real.arccos (-2 * α)) (1, 1) (1, -1) ε h →
          iteratedDeriv 6 (reducedFn (triPhase α) (Real.arccos (-2 * α), -Real.arccos (-2 * α)) (1, 1) (1, -1) h) 0
            = -60 * Real.sqrt 2 * SignType.sign α
statements.conclusion: (θ, −θ) and (−θ, θ), θ = arccos(−2α), are A5 points; with v = (1, 1), w = (1, −1) every reduced curve at (θ, −θ) gives reduced sixth derivative −60√2 · sign α at 0 (coefficient −sign α/(48√2) of s⁶ in the unit kernel coordinate s = √2 u)
statements.uniform_over: every reduced curve and every ε > 0

statements.label: TRI-Q
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.TriQuarticStatement
statements.summary: The reduced quartics: for `α ≠ 0`, at `(π/2, π/2)` with `v = (1, −1)`, `w = (1, 1)` the reduced quartic is `−12`; for `0 < |α| ≤ 1/2`, at `(θ, −θ)`, `θ = arccos(−2α)`, with `v = (1, 1)`, `w = (1, −1)` it is `12(8α² − 1)`; in both cases `v` spans the Hessian kernel and the cubic along `v` vanishes.
statements.summary_note: v is proved to lie in the Hessian kernel, not to span it; TRI-Q alone does not give IsA3Point. docs/statements.md, clarification TRI-a.
statements.lean_statement:
def TriQuarticStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, α ≠ 0 →
    ((∀ z, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (triPhase α) (Real.pi / 2, Real.pi / 2) ![(1, -1), z] = 0) ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (triPhase α) (Real.pi / 2, Real.pi / 2) ![(1, -1), (1, -1), (1, -1)] = 0 ∧
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (triPhase α) (Real.pi / 2, Real.pi / 2) ![(1, 1), (1, 1)] *
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 (triPhase α) (Real.pi / 2, Real.pi / 2) ![(1, -1), (1, -1), (1, -1), (1, -1)] -
        3 * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (triPhase α) (Real.pi / 2, Real.pi / 2) ![(1, -1), (1, -1), (1, 1)] ^ 2 = -12) ∧
    (|α| ≤ 1 / 2 →
      let θ := Real.arccos (-2 * α)
      (∀ z, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (triPhase α) (θ, -θ) ![(1, 1), z] = 0) ∧
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (triPhase α) (θ, -θ) ![(1, 1), (1, 1), (1, 1)] = 0 ∧
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (triPhase α) (θ, -θ) ![(1, -1), (1, -1)] *
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 (triPhase α) (θ, -θ) ![(1, 1), (1, 1), (1, 1), (1, 1)] -
          3 * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (triPhase α) (θ, -θ) ![(1, 1), (1, 1), (1, -1)] ^ 2 = 12 * (8 * α ^ 2 - 1))
statements.conclusion: at (π/2, π/2) with v = (1, −1), w = (1, 1): v lies in the Hessian kernel (∀ z, D²Ψ[v, z] = 0; rank one, D²Ψ[w, w] ≠ 0, is not part of TRI-Q), D³Ψ[v, v, v] = 0, and D²Ψ[w, w] D⁴Ψ[v⁴] − 3(D³Ψ[v, v, w])² = −12; at (θ, −θ), θ = arccos(−2α), with v = (1, 1), w = (1, −1): the same with value 12(8α² − 1)

statements.label: K2-L
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.ReducedOrderBoundStatement
statements.summary: Local bound of order `m`: a nonzero `m`-th derivative of the reduced function gives decay `t^{−(1/2 + 1/m)}` near `k₀`, uniformly over every linear term.
statements.lean_statement:
def ReducedOrderBoundStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (k₀ v w : ℝ × ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ → 2 ≤ m →
    v.1 * w.2 - v.2 * w.1 ≠ 0 → iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Ψ k₀ ![w, w] ≠ 0 → 0 < ε → ReducedCurve Ψ k₀ v w ε h →
      iteratedDeriv m (reducedFn Ψ k₀ v w h) 0 ≠ 0 →
      ∃ δ > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (y : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ),
        AmpBound 2 (Metric.closedBall k₀ δ) A M → 1 ≤ t →
          ‖oscInt2 (fun κ => t * Ψ κ + lin y κ) A‖ ≤ C * M * t ^ (-(1 / 2 + 1 / (m : ℝ)))
hypotheses: Ψ smooth on ℝ²; v, w spanning ℝ² (implied by the others), D²Ψ(k₀)[w, w] ≠ 0
h a reduced curve at k₀ for v, w on |u| < ε, ε > 0
m ≥ 2 with the m-th derivative of the reduced function nonzero at 0
A ∈ C², supported in closedBall k₀ δ, derivatives of order ≤ 2 bounded by M; t ≥ 1
statements.conclusion: |∫ e^{i(tΨ(κ) + y·κ)} A(κ) dκ| ≤ C M t^{−(1/2 + 1/m)}, with δ, C independent of A, M, y, t
statements.uniform_over: every linear term y ∈ ℝ², every amplitude in the ball, t ≥ 1

statements.label: K2-MA
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.MonomialAsymptoticStatement
statements.summary: Monomial asymptotics with an explicit remainder: the improper integral `C = ∫_ℝ e^{iσx^m} dx` has `Re C ≥ 1/(12m)`, and a plateau cutoff integral is `t^{−1/m} C` up to `4/(m t r^{m−1})`.
statements.lean_statement:
def MonomialAsymptoticStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (σ : ℝ), 2 ≤ m → (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
    ∃ C : ℂ, 1 / (12 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ C.re ∧
      Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => ∫ x in -R..R, Complex.exp (↑(σ * x ^ m) * Complex.I)) atTop (𝓝 C) ∧
      ∀ (b : ℝ → ℝ) (r t : ℝ), PlateauCutoff b r → 0 < t →
        ‖(∫ x : ℝ, (b x : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(t * σ * x ^ m) * Complex.I)) -
            ((t ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * C‖ ≤ 4 / ((m : ℝ) * t * r ^ (m - 1))
hypotheses: (b, r) a plateau cutoff (C¹, compactly supported, even, 1 on [−r, r], nonincreasing on [0, ∞)); t > 0
statements.conclusion: the improper integral C = ∫ e^{iσx^m} dx (symmetric limit) has Re C ≥ 1/(12m), and |∫ b(x) e^{itσx^m} dx − t^{−1/m} C| ≤ 4/(m t r^{m−1})
statements.uniform_over: every plateau cutoff and every t > 0

statements.label: K2-ML
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.MonomialLowerStatement
statements.summary: Monomial lower bound: `|∫ b(x) e^{itσx^m} dx| ≥ t^{−1/m}/(24m)` once `t^{1−1/m} ≥ 96 r^{1−m}`.
statements.lean_statement:
def MonomialLowerStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (b : ℝ → ℝ) (r t : ℝ), 2 ≤ m → (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → PlateauCutoff b r → 0 < t →
    96 * r ^ (1 - (m : ℝ)) ≤ t ^ (1 - 1 / (m : ℝ)) →
      t ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) / (24 * (m : ℝ)) ≤
        ‖∫ x : ℝ, (b x : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(t * σ * x ^ m) * Complex.I)‖
hypotheses: m ≥ 2, σ = ±1, (b, r) a plateau cutoff, t > 0
statements.uniform_over: every plateau cutoff and every t beyond the threshold

statements.label: K2-F
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.TorusLocalizationStatement
statements.summary: Fourier localisation: for a smooth `χ` supported inside `(−π, π)²`, a bound on every lattice coefficient of `e^{itΨ}` bounds the `χ`-localised integral at every real velocity `p`.
statements.lean_statement:
def TorusLocalizationStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ χ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ →
    tsupport χ ⊆ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi →
    ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (B : ℝ), Continuous Ψ →
      (∀ k : ℝ × ℝ, Ψ (k.1 + 2 * Real.pi, k.2) = Ψ k) → (∀ k : ℝ × ℝ, Ψ (k.1, k.2 + 2 * Real.pi) = Ψ k) →
      (∀ n : ℤ × ℤ, ‖∫ k in torusBox,
          Complex.exp (↑(t * Ψ k + ((n.1 : ℝ) * k.1 + (n.2 : ℝ) * k.2)) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ B) →
        ‖∫ k in torusBox, χ k * Complex.exp (↑(t * (Ψ k + lin p k)) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ D * B
hypotheses: χ smooth with tsupport inside the open box (−π, π)²
Ψ continuous and 2π-periodic in each variable; t, p real
every lattice coefficient |∫_{[−π,π]²} e^{i(tΨ + n·k)} dk| ≤ B
statements.conclusion: |∫_{[−π,π]²} χ(k) e^{it(Ψ(k) + p·k)} dk| ≤ D B, D depending on χ only
statements.uniform_over: every phase, every real t and every real velocity p

statements.label: K2-U
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.TriDecayUpperStatement
statements.summary: Fixed-coupling upper bound: `|triKernel α t n| ≤ C_α t^{−triRate α}` for all real `t ≥ 1` and all `n ∈ ℤ²`.
statements.lean_statement:
def TriDecayUpperStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℤ × ℤ), 1 ≤ t → ‖triKernel α t n‖ ≤ C * t ^ (-triRate α)
statements.conclusion: |triKernel α t n| ≤ C_α t^{−triRate α}, triRate α = 2/3 at α ∈ {0, ±1/(2√2)} and 3/4 otherwise (unnormalised kernel, triKernel 0 = latticeKernel)
statements.uniform_over: every lattice site and every real t ≥ 1 (not uniform in α)

statements.label: K2-D
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.TriDecayLowerStatement
statements.summary: Fixed-coupling lower bound: for all real `t ≥ T_α` some lattice site has `|triKernel α t n| ≥ c_α t^{−triRate α}`, `c_α > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def TriDecayLowerStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, ∃ c > 0, ∃ T : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, T ≤ t → ∃ n : ℤ × ℤ, c * t ^ (-triRate α) ≤ ‖triKernel α t n‖
statements.conclusion: there are c_α > 0 and T_α with: for every real t ≥ T_α some n ∈ ℤ² has |triKernel α t n| ≥ c_α t^{−triRate α}
statements.rate: t^{−2/3} or t^{−3/4} (lower bound; with K2-U the rate is sharp)
statements.uniform_over: every real t ≥ T_α (the site depends on t; not uniform in α)
